title: Oura Ring Or WHOOP? Which One To Buy
hook: Should you buy the Oura Ring? In my opinion yes, for most people, and absolutely everybody needs a sleep tracker.
body: Which one is best is a matter of preference, but I don't recommend the Apple Watch or Fitbit. My top two are the Oura Ring and WHOOP, and it depends if you prefer finger-based or wrist-based. The Oura Ring is more accurate because your finger is a better location, the app is better, and it gives you more actionable insights you'll actually use. WHOOP is better for workout tracking, it's more comfortable when you're gripping things or typing, and some people just prefer a wrist tracker.
close: Save this before you buy a sleep tracker.
